{{Quote|Squad Three! Report for patrol duty at once! Repeat! Squad Three! Report to me, on the double!|Captain Drezzel|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 84">[[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]]</ref>}}
'''Squad Three''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Drezzel]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], the squad was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seoul 5]]. When Drezzel was informed that a non-Imperial ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], had landed on Seoul 5, he sent out Squad Three to investigate. The squad and its members were destroyed when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] caused a [[Seoularian crystal]] accident to destroy [[Seoul 5 city]] in a massive cataclysm.
